thread:
Maya (PM): quick heads-up 1: we rolled out v1.3 last night. getting three customer reports about degraded embedding similarity on very long contexts. also a handful of asks for clearer streaming feedback in the UI.
Ethan (Eng): saw similar traces. batching heuristic tweak in last deploy seems to increase KV cache churn for sequences >10k tokens. repro is flaky but consistent on long-prefix corpora.
Noor (Runtime): adding logs shows more cache evictions around step N. might be an edge-case of the new packer.
Samir (QA): nightly flagged the long-prefix embed job. PR #472 failing. I can add a focused regression test, but need the failing corpora from CS.
Maya (PM): will pull the two customer logs and drop links here.
Priya (SRE): infra saw p95 latency drift coincident with rollout window (02:10 UTC). not CPU/GPU saturation, more a tail event. recommend a small canary.
Zoe (Design): streaming indicator request is small: show elapsed time + progress dot instead of spinner. low lift and customers say it reduces anxiety for long outputs.
Maya (PM): proposal: prioritize reliability this sprint. Plan: 3 days on embedding regression (hotfix toggle, repro harness, canary), 2 days on UX micro-improvement as parallel work. 60/40 split. Agree?
Ethan (Eng): agree. mitigation path: 1) implement rollback toggle to previous batching heuristic, 2) add targeted instrumentation and a synthetic job for repro, 3) implement a durable patch if root cause nailed. toggle first.
Noor (Runtime): I can prototype the toggle today. low-risk runtime flag that switches packer.
Samir (QA): once corpora are posted, I can wire the regression harness and create CI guard in 24h.
release-bot: rollout-plan created: canary 5% -> monitor [p95_latency, embed_cos_sim, error_rate] -> auto-rollback if embed_cos_sim drops >0.02 or p95 rises >15%.
Priya (SRE): I'll own canary execution and the runbook. suggest also an automated synthetic embed job running every 6h against long-prefix testset. will script it.
Ethan (Eng): for short-term safety, consider fallback to shorter-batch mode when detected sequence >8k tokens. cheap and reversible.
Zoe (Design): I'll prepare the small A/B asset and spec for the streaming indicator. recommend 10% A/B for two weeks then decide.
Maya (PM): owners: Ethan (bug/rollback), Noor (runtime impl), Samir (QA/regression), Priya (canary/runbook), Zoe (UX). target milestones: rollback toggle + canary in 48h, regression harness + CI guard in 72h, UX A/B in 72h.
Samir (QA): smoke checklist I'll follow:
```
- run synthetic repro harness
- compare embed cosine similarity vs baseline (threshold 0.02)
- run top-k ranking sanity check on 10 queries
```
Ethan (Eng): opening HOTFIX PR and will tag for priority review. Noor/Javier to pair on cache metrics.
Maya (PM): note for roadmap doc: this iteration shifts scope to reliability-first; small UX polish allowed if it reduces support volume. we'll re-evaluate backlog trade-offs at next planning.
Priya (SRE): one more ask 1: add an alert to paging if embed_cos_sim degrades >0.015 for 30m during canary. want early heads-up.
release-bot: monitor rule added: alert on embed_cos_sim < baseline - 0.015 for 30m.
Maya (PM): thanks all. check back in this thread after canary metrics. ping me directly if blocked. :pray:
